exposure: maternal circulating metabolic biomarkers (CLUL1, VCAN, FCRL1, RNASE3)
oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) 2 h glucose at 24 gw
cohort: The study participants were 44 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and macrosomic neonates, and 44 women with GDM and normal neonatal weight.
finding: A predictive model incorporating pre-pregnancy BMI, weight gain, parity, OGTT 2 h glucose, HDL, LDL, and plasma expression of CLUL1, VCAN, and RNASE3 at 24 gestational weeks demonstrated good performance for predicting macrosomia in women with GDM.
cross-section timing: 24 gestational weeks for maternal measurements; macrosomia is a birth outcome.
birth_weight: N/A (macrosomia and normal neonatal weight are outcomes, but specific weight ranges for inclusion are not provided)
gest_age: N/A (maternal measurements taken at 24 gestational weeks, but gestational age of babies at birth is not specified as an inclusion criterion)
